versions.short: The bill would make a series of technical corrections to title 49 of the United States Code, which covers transportation. Its main changes would fix cross-references, punctuation, and wording in the sections on federal direct loans and loan guarantees for transportation projects, the rules for calculating their costs, and how they are administered. It would also correct a few references in other transportation provisions, including the National Surface Transportation and Innovative Finance Bureau, the Surface Transportation Investment Act of 2021, and grant conditions, so that the code reads consistently.
